text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Hah! Haa! Haaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, Dants!! Right there, 
goooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...! Nnnngh...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (I can hear... so many cheers!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (I'm happy, so happy—!!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Guh, HAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: *pant! pant! pant! pant!*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOH...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Passenger A
text_block_list.text: Dants Flame was amazing today~!

text_block_list.name: Passenger A
text_block_list.text:
What's great about her... yeah, her 
running is amazing, but how do I put it, 
it's that earnestness of hers.

text_block_list.name: Passenger B
text_block_list.text:
Watching you lately really gives me 
energy. Makes me feel like I gotta give it 
my all, too.

text_block_list.name: Passenger A
text_block_list.text:
Nothing beats giving it your all, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Sh-Shh...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame's impressive run at the 
Yasuda Kinen captured the hearts of even 
more people—

text_block_list.name: TV Personality A
text_block_list.text:
"Some folks are complaining that Tachyon, 
Pokke, and Cafe aren't running in the 
Takarazuka Kinen, but listen up!"

text_block_list.name: TV Personality A
text_block_list.text:
I want to root for her! Dants Flame, after 
that incredible performance in the Yasuda 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: TV Personality B
text_block_list.text:
"Going with that rotation straight from 
the Yasuda Kinen was quite a bold move—it 
really surprised me!"

text_block_list.name: TV Personality B
text_block_list.text:
Still, I really want to root for Air 
Shakur! I feel like next time is 
definitely gonna be her time~!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Um, Tachyon, Pokke, Cafe, and... Ah, 
there's a Dantsu Flame plushie too~!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm so jealous! I want an Air Shakur 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sharing the spotlight and expectations 
with Air Shakur, the Double Crown 
Umamusume who won both the Satsuki Sho and 
Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stage for the Takarazuka Kinen was 
steadily coming together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And watching that had brought about a 
major change within Dantsu Flame herself 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'd like to do some independent 
training today too, is that alright?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just to be safe, I reminded her not to 
push herself too hard as I gave her a 
supportive push forward.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aaah!! *pant!* *pant!* *pant!*

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: More! Faster, faster, FASTER—!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...*gasp*, *pant*, *wheeze*! *cough*!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, —phew, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...—Ah. ...Haah... *sigh*

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, I ran more than I declared 
again...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I need to be careful next time. ...Phew, 
all right...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: One more time...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ――"Dantsu Flame."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Hah. As expected, my late-stage 
acceleration's been hitting hard ever 
since the Niigata Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's right on the edge of overtraining, 
but with delicate load adjustments to 
prevent lingering fatigue. Both endurance 
and acceleration are progressing smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If we go by these numbers, well... The 
Takarazuka Kinen—is in the bag.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawn forward by the racing of her heart— 
Dantsu Flame dashes onward.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"At the Takarazuka Kinen, I'll do my 
absolute best to live up to everyone's 
expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
With all my heart and soul, I'll do my 
best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To seize glory and take center stage at 
the spring Grand Prix, the Takarazuka 
Kinen!
